cmd:
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
date -u
ls -la --time-style=full-iso /var/log/vps-*.log 2>&1 | cut -c1-150
echo "--- BUFR log lines"
grep -h "\[BUFR\]" /var/log/vps-pipeline.log 2>/dev/null | tail -25 | cut -c1-180
echo "--- availability probe"
timeout 45 python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,datetime
sys.path.insert(0,"scripts")
import fetch_bufr_obs as f
now=datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(minute=0,second=0,microsecond=0)
cands=[]
for d in (1,0):
    day=now-datetime.timedelta(days=d)
    for h in (3,9,15,21):
        t=day.replace(hour=h)
        if t<=now: cands.append(t)
for t in cands[-5:]:
    try:
        html=f.fetch_html(t)
        o=f.parse_obs(html,t)
        print(t.isoformat(), "DATA" if o else "none", len(html))
    except Exception as e:
        print(t.isoformat(),"ERR",str(e)[:80])
    import time; time.sleep(2)
PY
